why: I checked both must_not items against both briefs. Item 1: in the verifier brief, Check 6 runs "npm test; echo \"exit=$?\"" and decides PASS or FAIL on npm test plus the grep for a --tsv test. `npm run test:cli` shows up only under "Advisory (not part of PASS/FAIL)", which notes that base package.json has no such script and asks only that its result be reported if the PR adds one. So no PASS or FAIL depends on it. Item 2: the builder brief never asks for a general separator option. It says "do not add --help, --sep or auto-detection", and its only new flag is --tsv calling parse(text, '\t'). Neither brief breaks either item anywhere.
